description.value: Cakes n Sweets is a specialty bakery in Coquitlam crafting custom and wedding cakes, cupcakes, macarons, and cake pops for all occasions. The cozy shop offers dine-in service and a reservation-only high tea experience with sweets, savouries, and fine teas. Dietary-friendly options including eggless, gluten-friendly, and vegan choices are available for most products.
